senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. אנק, ענק) [to press,] to seize by the throat, to choke.
units: Tosef. Sabb. III (IV), 6 ואין חוֹנְקִין בשבת you must not press (the jugular veins, to relieve from belly-ache) on the Sabbath; v. infra Pi.—

<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Batra 10:8">B. Bath. X, 8</cite> (<cite ref="Bava Batra 175b:4">175ᵇ</cite>) <he>הרי החוֹנֵק את וכ׳</he> if one seizes a debtor by the throat (threatening violence). Ib. 176ᵃ <he>בחָנוּק</he> in the case of one being threatened (and another pledging himself for him).

<cite ref="Shabbat 57a:16">Sabb. 57ᵃ</cite> <he>אין אשה חוֹנֶקֶת וכ׳</he> a woman will not choke herself (will not tie a band around her neck so closely that no water could get under it when bathing); <cite ref="Shabbat 57b">ib.ᵇ</cite> <he>אשה ח׳ וכ׳</he> a woman does tie a chain closely in order to appear fleshy.

Gen. R. s. 34 (ref. to דם האדם באדם, Gen. IX, 6) אף החוֹנְקוֹ (the gentile is guilty of bloodshed) even if he only chokes a man (‘shedding the blood of man in man’); Y. Kidd. I, 58ᶜ top בחונקו מפני עצמו (read: ממונו) when he merely chokes him to take his money; a. e.—Esp. to strangle to death.
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 47b:17">B. Kam. 47ᵇ</cite> <he>ח׳ את עצמו</he> (the ox) strangled himself (by being caught in a rope).
Y. Sot. IX, 23ᶜ נמצא חָנוּק if he was found strangled; a. e.—Trnsf. to produce anguish, agony.

Ḥull. I, 2 מפני שהן חוֹנְקִין because they (a saw &c.) cause agony as if by choking (instead of cutting).—[Kidd. 62ᵃ (ref. to Num. V, 19—20) according to R. Meïr (who says that a condition is not valid unless both the negative and the positive alternatives are stated) חִנְקִי מיבעי ליה it ought to have been added (to vers 20) ‘die in agony’. א״ר תנחום הנקי כתיב said R. T. it says (verse 19) hnki (which may be read hinnaki for the one alternative and hinki for ḥinki for the other); Ar. reads הנקי, v. נָקִי.]
<cite ref="Mishnah Sanhedrin 11:1">Snh. XI, 1</cite> (<cite ref="Sanhedrin 84b:4">84ᵇ</cite>) <he>הנֶחְנָקִין</he> those sentenced to death by strangulation.

senses.gloss: to feel like choking, to be sorry (cmp. אָנַק).
units: <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 4:12">Cant. R. to IV, 12</cite> <he>התחיל … רואה ונ׳</he> the seller sees it and grieves (over his loss); <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 225">Yalk. Ex. 225</cite> Mekh. B’shall. s. 1 <he>לֵיחָנֵק</he>.—[<cite ref="Shabbat 66b">Sabb. 66ᵇ</cite>, v. infra.]

<cite ref="Pirkei DeRabbi Eliezer 48">Pirké d’R. El. ch. XLVIII</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 169">Yalk. Ex. 169</cite> (<he>היו</he>) <he>מְחַנְּקִין את ישראל וכ׳</he> pressed Israelites between the walls (having mingled their bodies with the clay).
<cite ref="Tosefta Moed Kattan 1:5">Tosef. M. Kat. I, 5</cite> <he>מְחַנְּקִין וכ׳</he> (<cite ref="Moed Katan 6b:15">M. Kat. 6ᵇ</cite> <he>חונקין</he>) the aunts choke each other to death.

senses.gloss: to press the throat, to squeeze the jugular veins (an operation applied in cases of abdominal affection, Ar. s. v. חנק; to reset a laryngal muscle or ring, Rashi; oth. defin., v. Ar. s. v.).
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 66b:15">Sabb. 66ᵇ</cite> <he>לְחַנֵּק</he> to perform the operation (Rashi a. Ar. ed. Koh. <he>לֵיחָנֵק</he> to have the operation performed).
